Summary: B-01: As a booking clerk, I can book an appointment from a clinic template so sessions are not double-booked
Description:
As a booking clerk, I can book an appointment from a clinic template so sessions are not double-booked

Acceptance criteria: System blocks overlapping bookings for same clinician/room; tested on all 6 clinic templates

Summary: B-02: As a patient, I receive a reminder 48 h before my appointment
Description:
As a patient, I receive a reminder 48 h before my appointment

Acceptance criteria: SMS or email sent for 100% of booked appointments in test; message contains no clinical details

Summary: B-03: As a patient, I can reply to cancel so the slot can be reused
Description:
As a patient, I can reply to cancel so the slot can be reused

Acceptance criteria: Reply 'C' cancels and frees slot within 5 min; booking office notified

Summary: B-04: As a clinic manager, I see daily utilisation and no-shows by clinic
Description:
As a clinic manager, I see daily utilisation and no-shows by clinic

Acceptance criteria: Report available by 08:00 daily; figures match source within 1%

Summary: B-05: As a booking clerk, patient demographics load from the patient administration system
Description:
As a booking clerk, patient demographics load from the patient administration system

Acceptance criteria: Demographics returned in under 3 s; no manual re-keying

Summary: B-06: As IT, all access is role-based and audited
Description:
As IT, all access is role-based and audited

Acceptance criteria: Access review completed; audit log captures view/edit events

Summary: B-07: As a booking clerk, I can manage a wait list and offer cancelled slots
Description:
As a booking clerk, I can manage a wait list and offer cancelled slots

Acceptance criteria: Wait-list patients offered freed slot automatically
